text:
Alice (Product): Quick sync — follow-on for the streaming API launch. We have a memory leak reported by 3 customers (incl. Acme). Need to decide: emergency hotfix vs schedule into next sprint and keep pushing UX enhancements.
Ben (Eng): Details? severity, repro steps?
Deepa (Support): Customers hitting OOM after ~30–60m under heavy prefix caching. Two enterprise trials escalated. Acme asked for ETA.
Evan (Observability): Metrics: streaming session error rate +0.8%, latency stable. Heap growth visible in backend logs; kv_cache entries not evicting.
Ben (Eng): If it's kv cache leak, we can cap entries per session as a mitigation. Patch looks small: ~1 dev day + QA + canary.
Carla (Design): Separately, customers want session resumption UI + clearer timeout messaging — those are 5–8 dev days of design + front-end.
Alice (Product): Tradeoffs: hotfix (fast relief, pushes UX) vs bundle (delay hotfix until UX done). We also promised session resumption in roadmap inside two sprints.
Deepa (Support): @Ben can we ship a runtime config flag for Dedicated customers to cap cache as an interim?
Ben (Eng): Yes — add runtime config per-customer: kv_cache.max_per_session. Rolling patch via release process, low blast radius.
Ben (Eng): Code snippet for ops:
```
# runtime config
kv_cache:
  max_per_session: 1024
  ttl_secs: 3600
```
Alice (Product): Proposed plan:
1) Ship hotpatch: add config flag + canary today for affected accounts.
2) Root-cause fix scheduled in next sprint (full leak remediation).
3) Move session resumption UX into sprint after, but communicate timeline to customers.
Approve?
Evan (Observability): Agree. Also add an alert: heap_increase_rate > 0.2%/min for streaming workers.
Deepa (Support): :thumbsup: I'll draft a templated message to Acme and ask permission to run a canary restart (non-disruptive).
Ben (Eng): I'll open an RFC + PR. ETA: EOD tomorrow for canary rollout.
Alice (Product): Assigning: Ben = hotpatch + RFC, Evan = monitoring alert, Deepa = customer comms, Carla = resumption wireframes (end of week). Daily check-ins in #product.
deploy-bot: Canary started on prod-candidate-3 — rolling to 5% :eyes:
Carla (Design): I'll sketch quick flows so engineering can estimate integration impact.
Alice (Product): Thanks team — I'll update the roadmap doc + note the temporary mitigation in release notes.
